home: Home. Choose Explore, Practice, Story mode, or About me.
explore: Explore. Allow camera access to see your live preview.
practice: Practice. Choose a letter, or try Feel and Guess.
stories: Story mode. Choose a book to begin.
intelligence: About me. Your learning discoveries are here.
guess: Feel and Guess. What is the mystery word?
match: Find its match. Choose the matching object.
letters: Letters. Choose a letter to hear its Braille dots.
connect: Connections. A grown-up can help set up your devices.
feedback-help: What would you like to do? You can explore, practice, read a story, or hear about your progress.
feedback-help-explore: Your camera preview opens here. You can stop the camera, or ask to go somewhere else.
feedback-help-guess: Tell me your guess, or ask to try another word.
feedback-unavailable: That action is not available here.
feedback-retry: That action is unavailable. Please try again.
feedback-correction: What would you like to do instead? Say one destination, or ask for help.
